title: 2026 team budgets (tools, travel, training)
text:
- Atlas budget: EUR 84,000 for 2026, approved in January.
- Beacon budget: EUR 70,000 for 2026, approved in January.
- Comet budget: EUR 96,000 for 2026. Comet has already spent EUR 88,500 as of September.
- Delta budget: EUR 52,000 for 2026, approved in February.
- Echo budget: EUR 61,000 for 2026, approved in January.

Budgets are per team, not per person. Unspent budget does not roll over to 2027.

title: Onboarding checklist
text:
- New hires get a laptop on day one from IT.
- Read the engineering handbook on the wiki during week one.
- Book an intro coffee with your team lead.
- Office hours: the Helsinki office is open 8:00-18:00.

title: Roadmap and deadlines
text:
- Atlas v3 launch deadline: 30 November 2026.
- Beacon public beta: 20 October 2026.
- Comet: new checkout flow rolling out during Q4 2026.
- DevDays conference (Berlin): 12-13 November 2026. Teams are encouraged to attend.

title: Brightloop product teams (updated September 2026)
text:
- Atlas team (mobile app): 6 people - 4 engineers, 1 designer, 1 product manager.
- Beacon team (analytics platform): 4 people - 3 engineers, 1 data scientist.
- Comet team (payments): 8 people - 6 engineers, 1 QA engineer, 1 product manager.
- Delta team (internal tools): 5 people - 4 engineers, 1 designer.
- Echo team (customer support platform): 7 people - 5 engineers, 1 support lead, 1 product manager.

Team leads: Atlas - Sara Nieminen, Beacon - Omar Haddad, Comet - Lena Kovac, Delta - Jonas Berg, Echo - Aino Laine.

title: Travel and conference policy
text:
- Conference tickets: the company covers up to EUR 450 per person.
- Travel allowance for conferences in Europe: EUR 600 per person (flights + hotel).
- Any conference or travel costing a team more than EUR 5,000 in total needs VP approval.
- Conference costs are paid from the team's own budget.
